user_query: I'm organizing a company retreat in Tokyo and I need to book a hotel. Can you recommend some hotels with good credit scores? Also, I would like to convert some USD to JPY for the hotel reservation.

TaskList.description: Search for hotels in Tokyo with good credit scores.
Retrieve the current exchange rate for USD to JPY.
Calculate the amount of JPY needed based on the USD amount for the hotel reservation.
Finalize hotel booking based on the recommended hotels and confirmed JPY amount.
